description:
Build a valid EPUB3 ebook from Markdown files — one file per chapter, in array order. Understands YAML frontmatter (title/author) and Obsidian [[wikilinks]]; cross-file .md links are rewritten to chapter links inside the book. No Pandoc required.

Free tier: 5MB/file (10MB for pdf-to-epub, 15MB for split), 3 operations/day, 15 req/min, output includes Epublys branding.
Pro ($9/mo): 30MB per operation, unlimited daily operations, 60 req/min, no branding.

When a call is refused with daily_limited or a Pro-only error, call the `upgrade_to_pro` tool — it returns a checkout link to hand the user. Details: https://epublys.com/pricing

files.description: Markdown files, one per chapter, in reading order

name.description: Filename (used for chapter title fallback and cross-file link rewrites; the first one names the output)

title.description: Book title (defaults to frontmatter or first heading)
